plugin.name: Yui’s Home
plugin.description: Windows companion controller for the separately installed Yui Home desktop project: existing YUI chat, 3D building, Minecraft Java 1.21.6 synchronization and shared memories. Installing this plugin alone does not install the desktop, Java or Minecraft server.
plugin.short_description: Windows controller for Yui’s Home; requires the separate desktop runtime.
